snippet.title: Snail Mail - Gameplay Reveal Trailer - WASD Studios
snippet.description:
After a year of hard work and fun, the snail is finally out of the bag! 🐌

Snail Mail is a competitive card-based race to home game for 2 or 4 players. Who are you gonna play it with?
